summary: Implemented the JSON pretty-print feature without running anything, and nothing is committed. Changes: new rich/json.py (JSON renderable with __rich__ returning the stored no-wrap Text, plus a __main__ CLI entry that imports Console inside the guard); JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py (base style "json.", one combined pattern); six json.* keys in rich/default_styles.py; Console.print_json after print in rich/console.py; package-level print_json between print and inspect in rich/__init__.py (__all__ unchanged); tests appended to tests/test_console.py (test_print_json, exact ANSI expected output derived by reading the style code, unverified) and tests/test_rich_print.py (test_rich_print_json); docs: "Printing JSON" section in docs/source/console.rst, new docs/source/reference/json.rst linked from reference.rst; CHANGELOG Unreleased Added entry. Unverified: the tests have not been run. Judgment calls: the Console import in the CLI sits under the main guard, and the number lookbehind guards the hex branch too.
